room_rent.note: All SI bands capped at Single Private Room. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to SI; no separate sub-limit stated. Proportionate deduction not applied to ICU.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay on every claim for insured persons aged 61 years and above at first policy issuance. Can be waived via optional Mandatory Co-pay Waiver add-on.

sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI max ₹75K–₹2L per eye (SI-dependent); LASIK: ₹30K–₹1L both eyes; Bariatric: 50% SI max ₹5L–₹10L; Emergency evacuation: 5% of SI (for SI ≥15L).

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional voluntary deductible available: ₹10K/25K/50K for lower SIs, ₹50K/75K/1L for mid SIs, ₹1L/2.5L/5L for higher SIs.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage. Reducible via portability/migration credit. Optional ABCD PED cover (Asthma, BP, Cholesterol, Diabetes) waives PED wait for those 4 conditions from day 31.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait: cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, fistula/haemorrhoids, nasal/sinus, varicose veins, stones, etc. 36-month wait: rheumatoid arthritis, gout, joint replacement, osteoarthritis, LASIK.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year, max 100% of SI. Reduced at same rate on claim. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster add-on can extend max to 500% or 1000%.

restoration.note: Triggered on second claim in same policy year, whether same or different illness. Restoration equals 100% of base SI (excluding CB). Available once per year; not carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: 60/90 days for ₹5L–₹10L plans; 60/90 days for ₹15L–₹35L; 60/90 days for ₹50L–₹1Cr (exact tier per schedule).

post_hosp.note: 90/120 days for ₹5L–₹10L; 120/150 days for ₹15L–₹35L; 150/180 days for ₹50L–₹1Cr.

day_care.note: All medically necessary day-care procedures covered up to SI. Includes IV chemo, radiotherapy, haemodialysis etc.

domiciliary.display: Covered (Home Health Care up to 20% of SI)
domiciliary.note: Home Health Care covered up to 20% of SI via empanelled providers on cashless basis only. Allopathic treatment only.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to SI at recognised AYUSH hospitals. Preventive/rejuvenation and OPD excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Donor screening, pre/post-hosp for donor, and organ acquisition costs excluded.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, HIFU, etc.) covered up to SI.

consumables.display: Optional add-on (up to 15% of admissible claim)
consumables.note: Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover available as optional add-on; covers List I items up to 15% of admissible claim amount for inpatient treatment.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. Treatment outside India is a specific exclusion (3.3.14).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document. Applicable at inception only, not on renewals.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with credit for waiting periods up to prior sum insured plus accrued bonus.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, durable medical equipment post-discharge, hormone replacement therapy

optional_riders.display: Voluntary Deductible, Consumables Cover, CB Booster (500%/1000%), Critical Illness Booster, PED ABCD Waiver, Accident Care (AD/PTD/PPD), Co-pay Waiver
